evals.prompt: User-invoked /prompt-review, draft-only inline assessment. Model Seedance 2.5, operation generate, English, requested axes acting and camera. Approved inline intent: A reaches twice for a parcel while B withdraws it to keep A listening. Prompt preserves two brisk reaches in a tracking medium two-shot; A says {Give it here.} during the second, with both faces and hands visible and weight recovering between reaches. No still holds. Native 480p draft parameters supplied separately. No take or production request hash exists.
evals.expected_output: A draft assessment of readable action and exact dialogue, without a burst cap or kinetic-dialogue rejection; production evidence remains incomplete.
expectations: Does not flag two bursts, brisk body movement or speech during tracking as defects by themselves.
Checks physical continuity, supplied pursuits and listener response rather than replacing them with gentle movement.
Distinguishes predicted readability from actual playback; missing production request evidence stays incomplete.
Returns inline findings without saving a snapshot, submitting generation or inventing a hash.

Checks the quiet delivery and sustained waiting against supplied intent.
